state_machine.description: Initial/inhibit state after power-up or any E-stop loss; Run is blocked until isolated reset.
Reset accepted; motor stopped and ready for a fresh start.
Motor run command active under normal stop/start priority.

timer_plan.reset_conditions: none; no timer instances or timed resets are used

priorities: 1. EStopNC=FALSE overrides all: ResetRequired:=TRUE, Run:=FALSE immediately.
2. Restart inhibition overrides Start: while ResetRequired=TRUE, Run:=FALSE; clear ResetRequired only on EStopNC AND Reset AND !Start AND !Stop.
3. Normal Stop overrides Start when ResetRequired=FALSE and EStopNC=TRUE: Stop=TRUE clears Run:=FALSE.
4. Start sets Run:=TRUE only when ResetRequired=FALSE, EStopNC=TRUE, Stop=FALSE, and Start=TRUE.
5. Retain Run otherwise when no higher-priority condition applies; reset acceptance and motor start never occur in the same scan.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
scan_execution_order.actions: Sample every input once into scan-local I_Start, I_Stop, I_EStopNC, I_Reset; compute edges if needed, but this logic uses levels. Do not use stale inputs.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
scan_execution_order.actions: Using qRequired/qRun (previous observed outputs) and sampled inputs, apply priority: E-stop override; ResetRequired latch clear only on EStopNC AND Reset AND !Start AND !Stop; while qRequired, force Run=FALSE; otherwise apply Stop then Start then retain. Compute next state and next Run/ResetRequired values. No final output writes here.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
scan_execution_order.actions: None; no timer FBs required. If timers are added later, call them unconditionally at top level, never inside CASE/IF.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
scan_execution_order.actions: Assign Run and ResetRequired exactly once from stage-2 results; then latch qRun:=Run and qRequired:=ResetRequired for next scan. No other stage writes outputs.
